name: Kuroenji Hajime
source:
Protagonist of the 怨毒の槐 (The "[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Styphnolobium_japonicum]Enju[/url]" of Poisonous Grudge) Chapters.
(Note: The Japanese pagoda tree's kanji "槐" is a direct reference to the Kuroenji 黒槐 family name's second kanji)
